newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka slips again on Latvian stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka slips again on Latvian stock exchange.

text.p: Shares in Unibanka fell again on Wednesday on Latvia's infant stock exchange amid a day of brisk trade, the bourse said.
Unibanka dipped to 2.00 lats from 2.02 lats in turnover of 25,600 lats out of a total market volume of almost 105,000 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
The Daugavpils motor chain factory was the most active listing at almost 47,000 lats and its shares soared 14.13 percent to 1.05 lats.
